name: okongzinc-studio
description: OkongzINC Studio - self-hosted generative media studio (image, video, 3D) with a pluggable provider layer.
//: Workspaces are deliberately NOT used: npm symlinks workspace packages into node_modules, which fails with EPERM on Windows without Developer Mode. Each package installs independently instead.

scripts.setup: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix web install
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix web run typecheck
